'''Pich''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] for [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]]<ref name="Orbit" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> at the [[Time/Legends|time]] that Veshiv was on an inspection tour of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Empire Forever]]'', Pich, along with fellow aide [[Vestig]], accompanied Veshiv on the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Myrenia]]'' to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' after the EF76's [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]], claimed that the ''Far Orbit'' would be Veshiv's new [[Starship/Legends|ship]] for his travels. However, it was a trap, and the crew of the ''Far Orbit'', who were [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]], [[Capture of Coh Veshiv|captured]] Veshiv.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pich was first mentioned in the adventure ''[[The Capture of Coh Veshiv]]'' from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] as a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Pich's fate during Veshiv's capture is unknown, as the capture of Veshiv is played out by the players and is ultimately decided by them.<ref name="Orbit" />
